title: Why trust this model?

status.verification: Automated checks verify that the code implements the documented deterministic model consistently.
status.validation: Not validated against production data from an operating mine.
status.telemetry: Live values are synthetic model output delivered through MQTT and Eclipse Ditto, not field measurements.
status.safety: Not a certified mine design, traffic-management plan, safety assessment or forecast guarantee.

live_indicators.label: Ore mass-balance error
live_indicators.formula: opening ROM + excavated ore - (ore in trucks + ROM inventory + processed production)
live_indicators.unavailable_behavior: Show unavailable; never show a passing status without the returned field.

live_indicators.label: Observed rolling throughput
live_indicators.formula: processed tonnes in the last 60 simulated minutes / 1 h
live_indicators.unavailable_behavior: Show unavailable; do not substitute projected capacity.

live_indicators.label: Projected steady capacity
live_indicators.formula: min(fleet supply, excavator capacity, dump capacity, crusher capacity)
live_indicators.unavailable_behavior: Show unavailable; do not substitute observed throughput.

live_indicators.label: Projected bottleneck
live_indicators.formula: argmin of the four projected capacity limits

live_indicators.label: Live operational constraint
live_indicators.formula: rule-based interpretation of current resource utilization, queues and availability
live_indicators.unavailable_behavior: Show unavailable; do not replace it with the projected bottleneck.

key_parameters.label: Loading time
key_parameters.source: Four sourced shovel passes × sourced cycle time

key_parameters.label: One-way route length
key_parameters.source: Team choice compared with OpenMines route-distance distribution

key_parameters.label: Crusher planning capacity
key_parameters.source: Team planning assumption; not a manufacturer rating

safe_claims: The implementation is verified against its documented formulas and invariants.
The deterministic model conserves ore within the documented numerical tolerance.
Saved comparisons are reproducible synthetic planning cases under common starts and windows.
prohibited_claims: Measured production, savings, emissions or safety performance.
Guaranteed forecast accuracy, savings or throughput.
Certified safe bench, road or traffic design.
